observations.note: The fast drumming and intense riffing create a noticeable peak that transitions heavily into the breakdown.
The sitar cuts through initially but gets slightly swallowed by the dense guitar fuzz.
The sitar melody struggles against the busier drum and rhythm guitar frequencies here.
The main doom riff enters with decent weight despite a slightly muddy low-end.
The breakdown riff is suitably sludgy but lacks a bit of modern dynamic punch.
The drum and bass lock into a steady, albeit slightly mechanical, plodding doom feel.
The rhythm section drives the mid-tempo shift competently without feeling particularly organic.
The solo sitar tone exhibits a noticeably synthetic, keyboard-like quality.
The track abruptly ends instead of resolving or decaying naturally.
The collision of the dark scale and heavy doom instrumentation captures the requested atmosphere well.

overall_note: A decent attempt at doom-fusion with an appropriately dark atmosphere and heavy riffs, though the sitar tone sounds synthetic and gets buried in denser sections.
